extras.quota_verbatim: Per Development Mode title: Profile storage 2 GB, Content and configuration storage 2 GB, 5 GB UGC storage. 10 Development Mode titles per studio. Game Saves adds 256 MB per player per title.
extras.limits_verbatim: per-object-cap: 256 MB per player for Game Saves; request-rate: 100 service endpoint requests per 2-minute period per title player (≈10 uploads/min); 1,000 unique lifetime users per Development Mode title; per-object-cap on UGC requests tiered by request body size. Retention: none stated — data persists until deleted, no expiry clause found.
extras.egress_verbatim: Billed by API request, not by byte, for the core services. Data Connections egress is metered (Same Region West US 2 = Free; Zone 1 intra-continental $0.02/GB). Development Mode: 'As long as your title is in Development Mode, consumption isn't counted towards any of your billable meters.'
extras.chaining_verbatim: 4 GB (2 GB profile + 2 GB content) x 10 dev titles = 40 GB per studio, and studios are free and unlimited -> unbounded in aggregate. The sharper multiplier is Game Saves: 256 MB per player x 1,000 players per dev title = 256 GB per title x 10 titles = 2.5 TB per studio, and player identities are free to mint via LoginWithCustomID.
extras.tooling_verbatim: PlayFab REST APIs (Client/Server/Admin/Entity), official C#/Unity/JS SDKs. No rclone backend; a wrapper is ~50 lines against `https://<titleId>.playfabapi.com/`.
extras.agent_focus: game platforms as storage: cloud saves, game backends, mod hosting. Per-user total caps and whether save data is retrievable via API.

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
